quote: We randomly sample 200 instances from the test set of C-COPA and make prediction using Ex‑CAR. Then we employ three experts to give an explainability score belonging to {0, 1, 2} to evaluate whether the causality strengths derived by our approach are reasonable …

We employ three experts to give an explainability score belonging to {0, 1, 2} to evaluate whether the causality strengths derived by our approach are reasonable, where 0 stands for unexplainable, 1 stands for moderately explainable and 2 stands for explainable.
guideline: Experts were asked to assign an explainability score of 0 (unexplainable), 1 (moderately explainable), or 2 (explainable) indicating the reasonableness of the derived causal strengths.
